instruction: `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\TUTOR2.DSN` is a schematic. Traverse all primitive part instances in it and export `C:\\Users\\User\\Desktop\\pin_map.json`. The top-level JSON fields must be `total_parts`, `total_pins`, and `parts`. The `parts` array must be sorted ascending by `ref`, and each element must have the form `{ref, pin_count, pin_numbers}`. Requirements: - Multipart instances that share the same refdes must be merged into one entry. - `pin_numbers` must be merged, deduplicated, and sorted lexicographically. - `total_parts` must equal the length of the `parts` array. - `total_pins` must equal the sum of all `pin_count` values.
source: task.md #8 (Cadence 'OrCAD X DRC / ERC' blog; adapted to a pin-enumeration task since DBO-driven NoConnect placement is unreliable from a worker)
